skill_name: Compare and contrast articles of confederation and the Constitution.
workflow:
The Articles of Confederation was the first constitution of the United States and was adopted in 1777. It proposed a loose confederacy with the power distributed among the states, providing a central government with limited powers and no executive branch.

The Constitution was adopted in 1787, replacing the Articles of Confederation. It establisheed a strong federal government with powers distributed among three branches—legislative, executive, and judicial. There is also a system of federalism,
